contradiction: I will not stop (every turn) vs "it stopped" (every observation)
resolution: both true: the assistant turn ended; the machine had no third verb. A promise cannot add an actuator

contradiction: FAIL must be settled to prevent blind retry vs FAIL must be answered
resolution: not a contradiction once EXECUTE exists: settle after EXECUTE rounds are exhausted, not before

contradiction: routing is fine vs "routing is the root cause"
resolution: resolved by separating routing (three lanes, correct) from the continuation graph (two edges)

contradiction: archiving receipts is honest vs archiving broke the gate
resolution: both: preserve history in attempts/ AND teach the phase to handle NO_ATTEMPT

contradiction: the wrapper exists twice vs the job runs one copy
resolution: resolved by identifying which path the cron job resolves (profile scripts) and treating the other as inert
